Our programs

After-school reading clubs

Groups of six children meet twice a week in the school library with two volunteers. Each child chooses their own books and reads aloud for at least ten minutes a session.

One-to-one tutoring

A trained volunteer works with the same child for thirty minutes a week across a whole school year, using a structured phonics-led plan agreed with the class teacher.

Summer reading challenge

Six weeks of books, badges and reading diaries over the summer holidays, ending with a party in September where every child who finished six books gets a certificate.

Frequently asked questions

Who can join a club?
Any child in Years 2 to 6 at a partner school. Teachers nominate the children who would benefit most.
Does it cost the family anything?
No. Every program is free for children and their families.
How do volunteers get trained?
Two evening sessions and a shadowed first month, plus an enhanced background check.
